name: x-search
title: X Search
description: Search X posts by word, hashtag, account, date, and engagement, or type your own search query, and open the results on x.com.
author: raulg

commands.name: advanced-search
commands.title: Advanced Search
commands.description: Fill in X's advanced search and open it on x.com.

commands.name: quick-search
commands.title: Quick Search
commands.description: Type a search query and open it on x.com.

preferences.name: resultsTab
preferences.title: Preferred Tab
preferences.description: The results tab a search opens unless you choose another.

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Preferred Browser
preferences.description: Choose a web browser. Every installed application is listed, and one that cannot open the search link does not open it. Leave this empty to use your system browser.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
